narratives.title: Materials growth, understood through measurement.
text: I study how precursor chemistry and confined vapour transport shape low-dimensional materials. My work combines controlled growth experiments, transport modelling, microscopy and spectroscopy with reproducible Python analysis to connect processing conditions with material structure and optical response.

narratives.title: Research profile
text: I am a {{profile.role_short}} in the {{profile.group}} at {{profile.institution_short}}, working on tungsten oxides and transition-metal dichalcogenides. My doctoral research examines how source chemistry, source–substrate geometry and processing conditions influence material formation.

I independently acquire SEM/EDS and Raman/PL data. I have also collected and analysed Bruker XRD data for tungsten oxides and suboxides using reference-pattern matching, phase identification and lattice-parameter analysis.

I combine these measurements with local transport modelling and analysis of collaborator-acquired operando SEM images. I develop RamanPL_2D to turn spectroscopy datasets into fitted parameters, spatial maps and structured outputs. Earlier work at Oxford connected photonic-device measurements with design and simulation.

narratives.title: Growth and transport
text: Close-space CVD experiments and local transport modelling connect precursor chemistry and source–substrate geometry with low-dimensional oxide and sulphide formation.

narratives.title: Microscopy, spectroscopy and structure
text: Independent SEM/EDS, Raman/PL and Bruker XRD measurements relate morphology, elemental composition, crystal structure and optical response to processing conditions.

narratives.title: Research software and analysis
text: Python workflows for preprocessing, peak fitting, mapping and batch export of spectroscopy data, developed around experimental materials questions.

narratives.title: Close-space growth of tungsten oxide and sulphide nanostructures
text: How does a confined vapour geometry influence oxide and sulphide nanostructure formation?

I designed and conducted CSS-facilitated CVD growth and Raman/PL measurements, and co-wrote the first-author paper with Stephan Hofmann. My thesis also records my ex-situ SEM measurements and analysis of collaborator-acquired operando SEM images.
Operando SEM, TEM/EDX and XPS acquisition were performed by collaborators. Together, the growth and characterisation evidence links precursor delivery and growth conditions with material formation.

narratives.title: NaCl-assisted close-space growth of WS₂
text: How can source treatment and source–substrate geometry guide planar WS₂ growth?
I designed a close-space growth configuration and combined local COMSOL flow modelling with controlled CVD comparisons to assess precursor delivery and source/substrate cross-contamination.

Paired source–substrate characterisation and Raman/PL measurements connect growth conditions with material formation. I independently acquired SEM-EDS spectra and maps on NaCl-treated SiO₂/Si controls to verify salt deposition before growth.
This work forms part of my {{qualification:EDU-CAM:thesis}}; a first-author manuscript is {{status:P1:lower}}.

narratives.title: Optical characterisation of directly written MoS₂
text: How can spectroscopy assess the layer structure and optical response of directly written 2D material?

I contributed Raman/PL measurements and mapping to a collaborative closed-loop MoS₂ writing study, assessing local variations in layer structure and optical response. Other co-authors led the growth platform and complementary measurements.
The co-authored manuscript is {{status:S1:lower}}.

narratives.title: RamanPL_2D
text: From raw spectra to fitted parameters and spatial maps.
I developed a Python toolkit for Raman and photoluminescence preprocessing, peak fitting, spatial mapping, batch workflows and metadata-aware export.
The software provides reusable analysis workflows for experimental spectroscopy datasets.

narratives.title: Photonic resonance trimming
text: Earlier research · University of Oxford
My MEng research concerned micro-ring resonator tuning. I contributed measurements, design and simulations to the subsequent Nano Letters paper on photonic-resonance trimming.
This work connects my materials background with photonic-device analysis.

narratives.title: Training and laboratory contributions
text: I wrote a group SOP for Raman characterisation and analysis and trained researchers in SEM and Raman workflows. I also support student imaging projects and have demonstrated SEM imaging of two-dimensional MoS₂ to two NanoDTC cohorts.
My laboratory contributions include CVD reactor maintenance, pressure and precursor-delivery checks using mass-flow controllers and needle valves, and preparing departmental safety assessments.
